lessons.title: Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP) to Power Curve Transfer
lessons.summary: Convert wind speed, air density, and wind shear profile to aerodynamic turbine power output using nonlinear cubic and saturation curves.
checkpoints: Account for wake loss array efficiency factor (92%)
Map power output distribution accurately across seasons

lessons.title: Quantile Regression & Probabilistic Wind Power Density Function
lessons.summary: Train pinball-loss gradient boosting models generating P10, P50, and P90 power generation quantiles rather than point forecasts.

lessons.title: Asymmetric Under/Over-Generation Penalties Offer Optimization
lessons.summary: Derive optimal strategic bid quantity Q* under dual-settlement systems where short positions incur higher penalties than long positions.
checkpoints: Demonstrate bid shifting toward lower quantiles (P35-P40) to minimize asymmetric penalty risk
Prove mathematical optimality via newsvendor theorem

lessons.title: Multi-Year Revenue Backtesting vs. Naive Climatology Benchmarks
lessons.summary: Run full 3-year backtest across 105,120 settlement intervals, outputting Sharpe ratio, maximum drawdown, and net cash flow distributions.
inputs: Full historical market clearing and weather time series
checkpoints: Generate interactive equity curve and drawdown chart
Demonstrate +14.2% annualized revenue uplift over baseline naive bidding
